101.title: Refund eligibility
101.body:
Refund eligibility

An order is eligible for a refund when it was delivered within the refund window and the goods are unused, unopened and returned in their original packaging by the customer or an agent.

Refunds close after 14 days from delivery.

Example: write owner@example.test in the contact field of the request form when the customer has no account.

102.title: Refund payout
102.body:
Refund payout

A payout is released after the warehouse confirms the return and the finance team has approved the amount for the original payment method of the customer.

Refunds close after 30 days from delivery.

103.title: Payment methods
103.body:
Payment methods

Customers pay by card or by bank transfer and a payout always returns to the method that was used for the original order, never to a different method or account.

104.title: Support notes
104.body:
Support notes

Support agents record every refund request in the ticket tool and attach the delivery confirmation before they escalate any request to the finance team for approval.
